titulo: В and на: Location × movement and idioms

aula.objetivo: Choose between «в» (inside) and «на» (on top of, open space, event), use the position verbs and apply the choice to movement.

blocos.explicacao: The question "where?" versus "where to?". Here is one of the most important things in the whole lesson. Pay attention. Russian distinguishes between where (place) and where to (movement), and that distinction changes the case. ГДЕ? (Where?) → prepositional. You are already at the place. КУДА? (Where to?) → accusative. You are going to the place. English does the same with its little words: "in the room" (place) versus "into the room" or "to the room" (movement). Russian does it by changing the case after the same preposition. The rule: В + prepositional = "in / at" (where). В + accusative = "to / into" (where to). НА + prepositional = "on / at" (where). НА + accusative = "to / onto" (where to). It is the same preposition, but the case changes with the meaning. If it is a place, prepositional. If it is movement, accusative. Practical examples follow. That is all. The same preposition В or НА changes the case of the noun according to the meaning. Place → prepositional. Movement → accusative.

linhas.WHY: He is going to the shop (movement).
We are going to the square (movement).

linhas.TRANSLATION: He is going to the theatre.

blocos.titulo: The exceptions: the irregular nouns in -У/-Ю
blocos.explicacao: The exceptions: the irregular nouns in -У/-Ю. Here is a point that is rarely explained well. A few masculine nouns take -У (or -Ю) in the prepositional, instead of -Е. But careful: only when the preposition is В or НА. With О, they go back to -Е. Look at the list of the most common irregular ones: the ending is -У (always stressed), and it only works with В and НА. Compare. The rule: when В/НА mean a place, these nouns use -У. When О means "about", they use the normal -Е. They have a split personality. Example sentences follow.

blocos.titulo: Support tables and common mistakes in the prepositional
blocos.explicacao: Support tables: adjectives, possessives, pronouns and transport in the prepositional. Pronouns with О (about): обо мне · о тебе́ · о нём · о ней · о нас · о вас · о них. Means of transport (НА + prepositional): е́хать на авто́бусе, на метро́, на маши́не, на по́езде, на такси́; лете́ть на самолёте. The mistakes English speakers WILL make in the prepositional. Mistake 1: using the accusative instead of the prepositional. ❌ Wrong: Я в ко́мнату (meaning "I am in the room"). ✅ Right: Я в ко́мнате. You learned the accusative first (lesson 14) and tend to use the accusative ending for everything. But "I am in the room" is place, not movement, so it is prepositional. Mistake 2: using no preposition at all. ❌ Wrong: Я ко́мнате. ✅ Right: Я в ко́мнате. The prepositional never appears alone. It always comes with a preposition (В, НА, О, ПРИ). Without a preposition there is no prepositional. Mistake 3: using В instead of НА (and vice versa). ❌ Wrong: Я в пло́щади. ✅ Right: Я на пло́щади. A square is an open place, so it takes НА. The rule of open versus closed places solves 90% of this. Mistake 4: forgetting that a feminine in -ь takes -И, not -Е. ❌ Wrong: Я в но́че. ✅ Right: Я в но́чи. Mistake 5: forgetting that -ия takes -ии. ❌ Wrong: Я в Росси́е. ✅ Right: Я в Росси́и. Mistake 6: using О when the next word begins with a vowel. ❌ Wrong: Я говорю́ о Ива́не. ✅ Right: Я говорю́ об Ива́не. Before a vowel, О becomes ОБ, for euphony (like English "a" versus "an"). Mistake 7: using ОБ instead of ОБО. ❌ Wrong: Я говорю́ об мне. ✅ Right: Я говорю́ обо мне. Before мне, всём, всех and a few other words that begin with a consonant cluster, use ОБО. Mistake 8: forgetting that -мя takes -ени. ❌ Wrong: Я в вре́мя. ✅ Right: Я во вре́мени. Words in -мя get -ени in the prepositional, and В becomes ВО before this word. Mistake 9: confusing "where" and "where to". ❌ Wrong: Я иду́ в ко́мнате (meaning "I am going into the room"). ✅ Right: Я иду́ в ко́мнату. "I am going into the room" is movement → accusative. "I am in the room" is place → prepositional. Mistake 10: using -у/-ю with О. ❌ Wrong: Я говорю́ о лесу́. ✅ Right: Я говорю́ о ле́се. The irregular nouns in -у/-ю only work with В/НА. With О they go back to -е.

blocos.titulo: Где? and Куда? with в and на; на + languages
blocos.explicacao: The choice between в and на continues with movement: if you use в with «где?», you also use в with «куда?» (в школе → в школу). If you use на, you use на in both (на работе → на работу). With movement the word goes into the accusative (-а becomes -у). English: «at school» and «to school»; Russian: only the ending changes. «На» is also used for languages: «Я говорю на русском языке», «Я читаю на английском».
